working_on.feature: Antigravity IDE Window Title & Workspace Resolution Fix
working_on.task: Fixed workspace mismatch issue in DOM Bridge client when running inside Antigravity IDE on Linux, implemented triple-tier title/DOM parsing fallback, and created 16-case regression test suite
working_on.notes: DOM Bridge script updated, tested (16/16 tests passing), packaged into VSIX, and live injected script synced to Antigravity IDE workbench.

recent_changes.description: Fixed parseWorkspaceFromTitleString in media/autoplan-dom-bridge.js to extract workspace correctly from Antigravity IDE title layout [Workspace] - [Antigravity IDE] - [File], and added DOM fallbacks to Explorer Section and Agent header.

errors_encountered.error: Probe rejected: Workspace mismatch. Server workspace is 'EV-Plus-main', prober requested 'Auto-Plan Settings' or 'phase-01-focus-mode-20kw.md'
errors_encountered.solution: Rewrote parseWorkspaceFromTitleString to locate appName ('Antigravity IDE' / 'Visual Studio Code') index and extract preceding workspace folder part, added non-workspace tab filter and DOM fallback.

decisions_made: In Antigravity IDE and VS Code, the workspace name is always the segment immediately preceding the AppName segment in the window title.
Support Native Titlebar mode where .window-title is absent in DOM by falling back to document.title and DOM Explorer/Agent headers.
Allow case-insensitive matching for workspace probe validation in BridgeServer.
